findings.title: Agent file would ship in package
findings.detail: Personal permission allowlist; often holds pasted commands with keys.
findings.fix: Keep it out of the package (.npmignore or the package.json "files" list; your Python build tool's exclude list) and add it to .gitignore.
fix_steps: Add the line ".claude/" to .npmignore in the package folder. If .npmignore does not exist yet, first copy .gitignore to .npmignore: npm stops reading .gitignore once .npmignore exists. If package.json has a "files" list, make sure no entry in it includes this path.
Add the line ".claude/settings.local.json" to .gitignore so it is never committed either.
